map.每公斤体重每分钟最大摄氧能力（ml/kg/min），是心肺耐力的金标准。普通成年: Maximum oxygen uptake per kg of body weight per minute (ml/kg/min), the gold standard of cardiopulmonary endurance. Average adult men are about 35-45 and women 30-40; elite endurance athletes can exceed 60. It declines naturally with age.
